games.title: 7 Days to Die
notes: PC-to-console crossplay arrived with the V1.2 update. Turn on General → Crossplay Enabled; on PC the server also needs Easy Anti-Cheat on. Crossplay games are limited to 8 players.

sources.title: 7 Days to Die 1.2 and beyond
7 Days to Die crossplay answered (Insider Gaming)

games.title: Arma Reforger
notes: Crossplay depends on the server: it has to allow every platform, and PC-only mods can lock console players out. Consoles can't host their own dedicated servers.

sources.title: Cross-play brings a big rise in player numbers (Gameswelt)
Arma Reforger crossplay: PC, Xbox & PS5

games.title: Baldur's Gate 3
notes: Crossplay arrived with Patch 8 in April 2025. Cross-platform lobbies are under Multiplayer → Cross-Play and use a Larian account.
Mods work in crossplay as long as everyone in the lobby has the same mods installed.

sources.title: Baldur's Gate 3 Patch 8 is now live, bringing cross-play
Baldur's Gate 3 'Patch 8' now live on Xbox

games.title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 6
notes: Crossplay needs an Activision account, which also carries your progress across platforms.
Console players can limit matchmaking to consoles (including in Ranked). On PC, Steam and Battle.net players can't turn crossplay off; Xbox app players can.

sources.title: Crossplay in Black Ops 6 (Activision Support)
Warzone and Black Ops 6 Ranked console-only cross-play explained (Sportskeeda)

games.title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 7
notes: Crossplay is on by default; you can turn it off in the settings to only match players on your own console family. Progress is tied to your Activision account, so it carries across platforms.

sources.title: Is Black Ops 7 cross-platform? (Digital Trends)
Black Ops 7 crossplay and cross-progression explained (God is a Geek)

games.title: Conan Exiles
notes: PC, Xbox and PlayStation players can't join each other's servers; each console family plays across generations. Since the Enhanced (Unreal Engine 5) update in 2026, check that PC friends are on the same build.

sources.title: Is Conan Exiles cross-platform? (Prima Games)
Is Conan Exiles crossplay? PC, Xbox and PlayStation

games.title: Dead Island 2
notes: Dambuster's technical FAQ says Dead Island 2 won't support crossplay. Co-op works across console generations (PS4 with PS5, Xbox One with Series X|S), and Steam and Epic players can play together on PC.

sources.title: Dead Island 2 cross-play and co-op explained (GameSpot)
Is Dead Island 2 crossplay on PlayStation, Xbox and PC? (GamesRadar)

games.title: Dune: Awakening
notes: Xbox and the Microsoft Store version on PC play together (Xbox Play Anywhere). Steam and PS5 players aren't connected to other platforms yet. Funcom says full crossplay is coming after the console launch but hasn't given a date.

sources.title: Dune: Awakening's full console launch (RPG Site)
Dune: Awakening will receive cross-play support after its console launch (KitGuru)

games.title: EA Sports FC 26
notes: Crossplay is split by console generation: PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC play together, while PS4 and Xbox One have their own pool. Switch and Switch 2 don't have crossplay.
Crossplay covers Ultimate Team, Clubs and online Seasons. Turn it on or off under Online Settings → Matchmaking Options.

sources.title: Is FC 26 cross-platform? (The Signal)
EA FC 26: Crossplay, cross-platform and modes (Mein-MMO)

games.title: Elden Ring
notes: Co-op and invasions only work within one platform family: PS4 with PS5, and Xbox One with Xbox Series X|S. PC players only meet other PC players.

sources.title: Elden Ring crossplay: is there cross-platform multiplayer? (TechRadar)
Elden Ring crossplay (GameRevolution)

games.title: Elden Ring Nightreign
notes: Director Junya Ishizaki: "Similar to the original Elden Ring, there will be cross-generational play but not cross-platform play." PS4 and PS5 play together, as do Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S.

Does Elden Ring Nightreign have crossplay support? (Destructoid)

games.title: F1 25
notes: Crossplay works in F1 World, Ranked, Unranked, Leagues and custom lobbies. Turn it off under Settings → Crossplay to only match players on your platform.

sources.title: How to use cross-play in EA Sports F1 25 (EA Help)

games.title: Fallout 76
notes: PC, Xbox and PlayStation players are on separate servers. On PC, linking one Bethesda.net account to both the Steam and Microsoft Store versions shares your characters between them.
Bethesda said in February 2026 that it is looking into crossplay but called it a big technical job with no timeline.

sources.title: Bethesda is looking into Fallout 76 crossplay (Hitmarker)
Bethesda revisits Fallout 76 cross-play (Notebookcheck)

games.title: Farming Simulator 25
notes: PC, PS5 and Xbox Series players can farm together on the same server. PC mods that aren't on consoles will block console players from joining.

Farming Simulator 25 (PC) on the Xbox store

games.title: For Honor
notes: Crossplay joined the PC, PlayStation and Xbox matchmaking pools in March 2022 for PvP and PvE. Ranked, the campaign, training and arcade aren't crossplay.
Crossplay is on by default and can be turned off in the settings.

sources.title: For Honor crossplay FAQ (Ubisoft)
For Honor crossplay (TheGamer)

notes: GTA Online keeps every platform on its own servers. On PC, the Enhanced and Legacy editions are separate as well.

GTA 5: Does the game support cross-platform?

notes: It Takes Two's online co-op only works with a partner on the same platform, and that includes the Friend's Pass. Hazelight's next game, Split Fiction, does have crossplay.

notes: Quick Play, Conquest and custom games mix every platform. Ranked is split: PC players only play ranked against PC, while PS5 and Xbox share a console ranked pool.

notes: Crossplay is on by default (Options → Game Settings). There's no cross-save: Capcom keeps save data and paid DLC separate on each platform.

notes: Progress carries across platforms through cross-progression. Console players are matched with other console players unless they party up with someone on PC.

notes: Crossplay needs a Starbreeze account. You're offered crossplay on first launch, and you can change it later in the settings.

notes: Crossplay includes VR players on PC and PS VR2. To play with a friend on another platform, host a room and share its code; you both need to be on the same regional server.

Phasmophobia coming to PS5, PS VR2 and Xbox Series (Gematsu)

notes: Crossplay arrived with the console launch on July 15, 2025. There's no cross-progression, so PC progress doesn't carry over to consoles.

notes: Red Dead Online has no crossplay or cross-progression. PS5 and Xbox Series players run the PS4 and Xbox One versions, so they can play with last-gen friends on the same console family.

notes: Steam and Epic players can play together once they link accounts. Consoles only play within their own family, and there's no PC-to-console crossplay or cross-progression.

sources.title: Is Risk of Rain 2 cross platform? Answered (Prima Games)

notes: Crossplay arrived with the 1.0 launch on September 15, 2026. The host turns crossplay on when creating or loading a world. Worlds hold up to four players (six on dedicated servers), and there's no cross-save.

games.title: Satisfactory
notes: Steam and Epic players play together, and PS5 and Xbox players play together, but PC and console can't mix. Coffee Stain keeps them apart because PC mods and save edits can destabilise a session. Consoles need an Epic Games account to host or join.

notes: Full crossplay and cross-progression: your unlocks follow your account between PC and console. There's no PS4 or Xbox One version.

notes: Only one player needs to own the game: the other can join free with the Friend's Pass on any of these platforms. Invites go through the in-game EA friends list, so both players need an EA account.

notes: PS5 and Xbox players play together, but Riot keeps PC separate for competitive fairness. Your Riot account, skins, battle pass and progress are shared between PC and console.

notes: Online co-op (added in update 1.14, October 2025) only works inside one ecosystem: Xbox consoles with the Microsoft Store/Game Pass PC version, and PS4 with PS5. Steam, Switch and mobile players only play with the same platform.

notes: Turn crossplay on or off at the bottom of the Options menu. Cross Platform Save lets one account's progress follow you to every platform, linked through a PC account.

notes: Steam players can't opt out of crossplay. On Xbox and the Microsoft Store version you can turn it off in Account Settings to play only with Xbox players. Progress is shared between Xbox and the Microsoft Store version (Play Anywhere), but not with Steam or PS5.

notes: Campaign and Operations (PvE) have full crossplay. In PvP (Eternal War), PC players and console players are matched in separate pools.

notes: Progress is tied to your Kuro Games account and syncs across every platform. Co-op only works with players on the same server region (for example, America or Europe).
